portal_hypertension.title: Radiomics-Based Assessment of Portal Hypertension Severity and Risk Stratification of Cirrhotic Patients Using Routine CT Scans.
portal_hypertension.journal: Liver international : official journal of the International Association for the Study of the Liver
portal_hypertension.authors: Sin C, Watzenboeck ML, Iofinova E
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究（样本量约为 357）。核心观点：开发和验证基于 CT 的放射组学模型，以评估 HVPG 并预测肝硬化患者肝脏相关事件（LRE：失代偿和肝脏相关死亡）的复合终点。 临床提示：这项回顾性研究包括 357 名接受侵入性 HVPG 测量的肝硬化患者、120 名肝脏健康对照者（训练队列）以及 85 名和 100 名肝硬化患者（内部和外部验证队列，
portal_hypertension.abstract: To develop and validate a CT-based radiomics model to assess HVPG and predict a composite endpoint of liver-related events (LRE: decompensation and liver-related death) in patients with cirrhosis. This retrospective study included 357 cirrhosis patients, who received invasive HVPG measurements, 120 liver-healthy controls (training cohort) and 85 and 100 cirrhosis patients (internal and external validation cohorts, respectively), and contrast-enhanced abdominal CTs. After volumetric segmentation of the liver and spleen on CT, Bayesian parameter optimization was used for selection of extracted features and hyperparameter tuning in random forest or elastic net models.
